findings.passage: While we already have voter ID laws in the books, this resolution enshrines the popular voting requirement in our state constitution, which ensures that the security measure can be enforced well into the future. findings.note: Statement issued in his name after the Senate passed the resolution to put a voter ID requirement in the state constitution.
